news.title: Dani Olmo: ‘Winning the World Cup changes you, it changes your life’
news.lede: One of Barcelona’s eight World Cup winners reflects on how Spain’s triumph is inspiring them in the Champions League. Dani Olmo nods towards his right arm. “Look: goosebumps,” he says. The Spain midfielder is sitting in a back room at Barcelona’s Joan Gamper training ground trying to pinpoint the moment he knew he was a world champion.

news.title: How Afia Arabia turned the World Cup into a 42-million-view food tournament
news.lede: Every World Cup creates a second competition away from the pitch. As national teams fight for progression, brands fight for association. Sponsors activate global rights, advertisers recruit football stars, creators fill social feeds and companies search for some credible way to attach themselves to the cultural moment. Against that backdrop, a cooking-oil brand might not appear to have the most obvious route into football.

news.title: Ballon d'Or Feminin 2026 Power Rankings: Who will end Aitana Bonmati's three-year dominance of the Women's Golden Ball?
news.lede: Aitana Bonmati has won each of the last three Ballons d'Or Feminin - but the accolade will go to someone else in 2026. Will it be two-time winner and fellow Barcelona star Alexia Putellas who reasserts herself as the best player in the women's game? Or could there be a new name on the honour roll when the Golden Ball is handed out in Paris in October? Unfortunately, Bonmati suffered a fractured fibula back in November, one which required surgery and kept her on the sidelines until she made her return in May.

news.title: Ballon d’Or Goalkeeper of the Year: All nominees
news.lede: And this year, it brings a new set of nominees with results influenced by not just club football, but also the FIFA World Cup 2026. The World Cup had a massive impact on who ended up being nominated and nowhere is this more apparent than with the Yashin Trophy. The Yashin Trophy, named after the goalkeeping legend Lev Yashin, will be awarded to one goalkeeper each in the men’s and women’s categories. This year, ten nominees for men’s and five nominees for women’s have been selected.

news.title: Showdown in Samoa — the four sides aiming for the FIFA U-20 Men’s World Cup
news.lede: Four Oceania teams will go head-to-head on Friday to claim the two available spots at next year’s FIFA U-20 Men’s World Cup in Azerbaijan and Uzbekistan. The winners of Friday’s OFC U-19 Men’s Championship semi-finals at the Samoa Football HQ in Apia get the chance to represent the region at the 24-nation global tournament. The Solomon Islands will take on Tahiti in the first semi-final before New Zealand face New Caledonia in the second match. Main photo: The captains gather ahead of Friday’s semi-finals.
